title: Homage to Shakespeare
credit_line: Black Mountain College Collection, gift of Barbara Beate Dreier and Theodore Dreier, Jr. on behalf of all generations of Dreier family
description:
Program for production of "Homage to Shakespeare!" Mimeograph on paper printed on one sides.
HOMAGE TO SHAKESPEARE 1
Black Mountain College
August 29, 1942
PROGRAME
DIRECTOR’S PROLOGUE: John Evarts
PROLOGUE TO HENRY V: Eric Bentley
RICHARD II:
Richard is taken prisoner by Bolingbroke.
Richard goes to prison, the Queen to France.
Richard: Paul Snyder. Northumberland: Herbert Openheimer.
The Queen: Patsy Lynch Bolingbroke: Eric Bentley
IV.	RICHARD III: Richard courts Lady Anne whose husband and father-in-law he has murdered.
Richard: Eric Bentley Anne: Barbara Pollet.
V.	MACBETH: King Duncan is murdered.
Macbeth: Paul Snyder Lady Macbeth: Barbara Pollet.
INTERMISSION
VI.	THE TAKING OF THE SHREW: Katharina meets her match.
Petruchie: Herbert Oppenheimer Katharina: Barbara Payne.
VII.	TWELFTH NIGHT:
Orsino in love.
Viola courts Olivia on Orsino’s behalf.
A drinking party.
Poetry and song.
Valentine: John Evarts Orsino: Eric Bentley
Sir Toy: Patsy Lynch Viola: Barbara Pollet
Sir Toby: Eric Bentley Sir Andrew: Paul Snyder
Malvolio: Erwin Straus Maria: Maja Tschernjakow
Clown: Anatole Holt
Master of Ceremonies: John Evarts
Stage Manager: John O’Neill
Director: Eric Bentley
FINIS
